defects.summary: applyDiscount accepts percent outside 0-100, producing negative or inflated totals despite the documented range.
parseQuantity returns NaN or truncated values ("2.9" -> 2, "abc" -> NaN, "-3" -> -3) with no validation.
isExpired uses > so a session is still valid at exactly expiresAt, contradicting 'valid strictly before its expiry instant'.
